name: Naseem
note: Flowers/cakes/gifts delivery operating pan-Middle-East (UAE, KSA, Jordan, Egypt); primary listed contact is a Dubai +971 4 landline (Saudi number is WhatsApp-only), indicating a UAE-HQ'd operator running a .sa storefront. Fails Gate 1 (in-country Saudi HQ not establishable), matching the Ferns N Petals/desertcart pattern.

name: Magaza
note: Independently confirmed the domain is hijacked: it currently serves Chinese-language VPN/proxy-node spam ('Dragon Accelerator', clash nodes), not a Qatar shopping site. No relocated live 'Magaza' storefront is findable; satisfies Gate 4/7 no-live-site standard.

name: Gas Station Development Company (Orange)
note: Verified as a fuel-station development/franchise/investment operator (Al-Khobar HQ, 100+ stations, O Xpress convenience as a secondary in-station format), targeting investors rather than consumers. Fuel stations are hard-excluded under Gate 2.

name: rebound
note: Live activewear/gym-wear e-commerce (men's and women's) operating in Riyadh with 1-2 day local delivery; Rebound Holdings is Riyadh-HQ'd. Server currently responds (rate-limited, not the 402 'store unavailable' of a frozen shop), so the prior 'dead Shopify' exclusion was a sloppy/transient dead-site call. Approved apparel category, Saudi HQ.

name: UNIVERSAL COLD STORE TRADING COMPANY LIMITED
note: Independent sources show a real 125+ branch grocery/supermarket chain across Dammam, Yanbu, Hail and Turaif (Saudi-HQ'd, Dammam); the dairy/meat/juice factories coexist with it, so the 'B2B/manufacturing hybrid' exclusion is the corrected-away Gate 2 error. Held only because no live digital channel is confirmable (universalcsc.com redirects to the hijacked primemarkets.com.sa; alnokhbamarkets.com is a bare holding page; app unverified).

name: silkra
note: Could not independently verify. The domain's server currently responds (HTTP 429 rate-limit, consistent with a live bot-protected Shopify rather than a truly dead store), which undercuts the original 'dead Shopify' finding, but with no search budget the catalog could not be read nor the underlying business confirmed either way.

name: رنين | Raneen
note: raneen.com.sa is a Saudi business-consulting/development entity (~67 employees), not a retailer; the well-known electronics/appliances superstore 'Raneen' is a separate Egypt-HQ'd company (raneen.com/.co, ~50 stores in Egypt). Neither reading yields a Saudi-HQ'd retailer, so the exclusion holds (Gate 2 services / Gate 1).

name: SPAR Saudi Arabia
note: spar.sa is a live SPAR Express KSA site, but SPAR's Saudi operation is run by Al Sadhan (SPAR International's KSA market-entry partner), which is already counted IN. Correctly consolidated as a duplicate under Gate 6, not a separate account.

name: Dee Line
note: The store blocks automated reads with HTTP 403 (consistent with a live bot-protected Shopify, not a dead store) and beauty/makeup/perfume is an approved category, but with no search budget Saudi HQ, catalog scale, or a working cart could not be confirmed. Genuinely unresolved.

name: tomorna
note: Live Saudi B2C premium-dates store (SAR pricing, free shipping over 250 SAR, many date varieties plus derivatives) with a SEPARATE dedicated wholesale-buyer login. Excluded on the explicitly corrected-away 'B2B arm alone disqualifies' reading; the substantial dedicated consumer grocery/F&B operation passes on its own merits (directly parallels the Go Fresh PASS example).

name: Trolley Convenience Store
note: Verified as a real, large Kuwaiti convenience chain (120+ stores, 10,000+ products, 1,000+ employees, listed on Boursa Kuwait) -- passes Gate 1/2/3/5 on category, geography and scale. Held only because the corporate site is investor-relations-focused with no cart and a live transactional online store or app (Gate 4) could not be confirmed without search budget.

name: تجارة بلا حدود -  unlimited trade
note: Records describe a real Riyadh home-essentials/beauty/family-goods e-commerce retailer (founded 2007, cash-on-delivery), but utrade.sa does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) and the on-file utradeksa.com is the confirmed-hijacked domain, so no live transactional channel is confirmable on either domain. Unresolved.

name: Ajlan & Bros
note: Riyadh-HQ'd (since 1979); ajstore.com is its live consumer e-commerce for men's clothing (thobes, ghutra, yashmagh, ready-made wear) with free delivery over 199 SAR. Apparel is approved; the manufacturing/wholesale lines coexist per the corrected Gate 2, and the NAICS-only exclusion (holding/mfg/real-estate codes) improperly ignored the dedicated retail storefront.

name: اجدان | Ajdan
note: Verified as a Saudi real-estate and lifestyle developer ('Premier Real Estate & Lifestyle Developer KSA'), with no consumer product catalog or cart. Real estate is hard-excluded under Gate 2.

name: Arab News
note: Arab News is a newspaper / news-media publisher, not a retailer or e-commerce store. Media/publishing is outside the approved categories; exclusion correct.

name: SAN INTERNATIONAL COMPANY LIMITED
note: Jeddah-based brand-management/distribution company ('brands we own and partner with' across watches, leather, footwear, clothing, home); the site is an informational portal with no shopping cart or own consumer storefront. Matches the Alireza-Holding FAIL pattern (brand-agency/distribution, no retail arm to evaluate).

name: Saudi Research & Publishing Company - SRPC
note: SRPC is a media/publishing company (the SRMG publishing arm behind titles such as Arab News/Asharq Al-Awsat), not a retailer. Publishing is outside the approved categories; exclusion correct.

name: New You Medical Center
note: Verified as a Riyadh medical/aesthetic center (obesity surgery, dermatology, dentistry, laser, ophthalmology) with two clinic branches, offering appointment booking -- not product retail. Healthcare/clinics are hard-excluded (Gate 2).

name: SLIC
note: Saudi Leather Industries (Dammam) is a footwear MANUFACTURER whose identity is B2B/industrial (safety/military footwear supplied to Aramco, SABIC, MoD), so the NAICS-only 'footwear manufacturing' exclusion was improper (footwear is an approved category and it runs a live consumer store, slicstore.com, that blocks bots with 403 rather than 402). Held because the consumer retail arm's substantiality/dedication could not be confirmed (SKU count and store footprint unverified); it may be a thin storefront on an industrial business.

name: Kadoon Company
note: Riyadh-based health/wellness/beauty group dominated by hard-excluded lines: 18 dental clinics, medical spas, spa-services, and B2B import/distribution of spa furniture/equipment; its cosmetics e-commerce serves mainly B2B/professional clients (hotels, beauty centers). No substantial dedicated consumer retail chain -- not the Lazurde pattern.

name: Golden Cala
note: Jeddah-HQ'd; runs its own D2C e-commerce (goldencala.com) selling contact lenses (LensMe and others), makeup and oral care -- approved beauty/cosmetics/optician category with repeat-purchase consumables. Its import/distribution arm (supplying Nahdi, Magrabi, Faces, etc.) is a separate fact per the corrected Gate 2; the wholesale-NAICS-only exclusion was improper.

name: SMSA EXPRESS - UK LIMITED
note: SMSA Express is a courier/express-logistics and last-mile shipping company, not a consumer retailer. Logistics/freight/3PL is explicitly hard-excluded (Gate 2).

name: BOCH
note: Domain does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) -- no live storefront or app findable -- and the on-file NAICS point to medical-instrument / toiletries manufacturing. With no confirmable consumer retail channel, defaults OUT per Gate 7.

name: Sadara Chemical Company
note: Sadara is a large petrochemical manufacturer (the Aramco/Dow complex in Jubail), an industrial B2B producer with no consumer retail operation. Manufacturing/chemicals is hard-excluded (Gate 2).
